context: M1 escort leg 2: W 26th to W 28th. Wholesale gates rattling down; the Flower District is dark to the west.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Smell that? Flower guys hose the street all morning. Funeral smell till dark.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Florists west of Sixth. Furs past Seventh. I know the map, Carl.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Sure you do. Question is who owns the map now. The Commission blew it up.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Somebody's redrawing it. Quiet. With a nice pen.
